method: FX contract: alpha = classes of the categorical soft-label master (tone-group version, label-exact centres), identical for every CLUT with the same transparent entries; RGB free of class thresholds = continuous index field t (normalised convolution of the native index inside the opaque silhouette, sigma 0.55 texel: low frequencies locked to native) + band-limited turbulence (0.35 index steps) when the CLUT is a luminance ramp (Spearman >= 0.85), else categorical soft labels; per 32x32-texel cell light-energy gate vs native (scalar correction outside +-6 %). No material layer and no generated detail in this revision.
render_formula: t = smoothed native index (+ turbulence); rgb = lerp(P[floor t], P[ceil t]) inside the opaque silhouette; class = class(P[l_0]) of the soft-label master; energy gate per cell; class stamped at every texel centre

class_validation.convention: class at pixel floor((i+0.5)*scale) of every native texel == class(CLUT[native index]); class 0 = raw 0x0000, 255 = STP, 127 = opaque

alpha_channel: categorical PSX classes (0 = raw 0x0000, 127 opaque, 255 STP), NOT opacity; exact at every native texel centre

glow.used: shape (palette is not a ramp: categorical soft labels)
shape (palette is not a ramp: categorical soft labels)

honest_read: Class-exact and native-faithful: silhouettes, holes and transparent texels are exact at every texel centre; at in-game size (panel C) the sprites read as a cleaner, slightly softer version of native.

Neither review CLUT is a luminance ramp (5C04E373 grey 3FF2DBD5, BD968A3C lavender/red A132B3B3), so the continuous glow field was not used: radial gradients (the burst discs on 5C04E373) become terraced octagonal tone plateaus at 16x, i.e. visible banding, and smoke becomes posterised blobs.

High-contrast speckle (the BD968A3C fire ring, flame-cone edges) is not blended (the speckle colours are not near under the page CLUTs), so it becomes rounded dots at 16x; in motion this speckle may twinkle like the native does.
No generated detail: this is not the fx_v2 SDXL-detail look of the Stage 1 effects; flames and smoke have no internal structure beyond the native tones.
The A132B3B3 render of BD968A3C (lavender fill around red/orange fire) looks like a wrong pairing; colours come only from the captured CLUT phases.
known_limits: All keys are predicted-static (likely pairings); import only after the stage-5 run confirms each key. The flaming spinning disks almost certainly use runtime CLUT phases (AQ-05): render only the captured phases from the master.
One render per page; 27 further static predicted keys render from the same masters later; 5 palette-hold keys wait for AQ-05.
Energy gate per 32x32 cell holds the light energy within +-6 % of native for the review CLUT only.
FX v2 SDXL img2img detail (GPU) for 512 and 576 is not done.
Review panel C is a SIMULATION (bilinear from runtime-2048, no mips, 9 px per texel); no in-game capture exists.
